title: Physical Education · Year 1
_why: The identity layer: what makes this book ITSELF and not any other title in the series. Declared once, here, and read by the build. Consistency comes from the invariants (geometry, type, page map, rung n = unit n); identity comes from these five decisions, and none of them may be copied from another subject.

voice.narrator: a grown-up who is glad to see you and never keeps score. Speaks in the second person, in short sentences a six-year-old can hold in their head.
rules: an instruction is at most seven words
no instruction begins with 'you must' or 'you should'
every invitation has a way out in it: 'if you want to', 'when you are ready'
the words 'win', 'best' and 'good at' never appear about a child
the book asks questions it does not answer for the child

cast_and_place.place: the meadow behind the school, with the hall waiting behind its open doors: wooden floor, wall bars, mats in a stack
cast_and_place.rule: the six appear in narrative scenes, never as decorations; Willow is the one who names what happened

signature_page.what_it_is: one movement, one minute, the child's own timing: a big card with three tries to tick, a space to draw the pose, and no mark from anyone else
signature_page.why_it_belongs_to_this_subject: no other subject can ask a child to do the learning with their whole body; the page is where the body is the pencil

rhythm._rule: weights: E energy, D dense, R response, B breath (one large image, 25 words at most), S signature. No type twice in a row, no type more than twice in a unit, never two dense pages in a row, never three response pages in a row.
rhythm.unit1: E E D R B D S R R
rhythm.unit2: E D R B D R S D
rhythm.unit3: E D B R D S R B
rhythm.unit4: E D R D S B R R B
rhythm.unit5: E R D B S D R B
rhythm.unit6: E D R B D S R D B
rhythm._breath_rotation: the breath page changes position in every unit, so the book never settles into a page turn a child can predict

cover_picture: the meadow at first light with the six mid-movement along a chalk line, the hall's open doors behind them
response_types: tell a partner what you saw
teacher_rescue: one line only, on the check page, for the adult who is stuck with a class: what to say, not what to do

_sources_of_truth.daily_content: the master's teaching, kept on its own page: nothing the teacher placed is deleted
